raw:
SELECT "CDSCode", "School Name", "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" 
FROM main."frpm" 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda' 
  AND "Academic Year" = '2014-15' 
  AND "School Code" IS NOT NULL 
  AND "School Code" != '0000000'
ORDER BY "CDSCode";
